lesson: A pre-results veto on a top-ranked momentum stock may cost more than it saves: so far the vetoed names that reported a beat rose sharply (judge on 5-day excess, not 1-day).
examples: + 2026-10-28 AMGN vetoed before 3 Nov results (beat: revenue +8%, non-GAAP EPS +14%): 5-day excess vs S&P +6.75% (close 28 Oct to 4 Nov) | + 2026-10-28 ABBV vetoed before 30 Oct results (beat, FY26 outlook and dividend raised): 5-day excess vs S&P +3.38% (close 28 Oct to 4 Nov) | - 2026-10-29 NYKAA vetoed before 4 Nov results: 5-day excess vs Nifty -7.90% (352.90 to 349.75 vs Nifty +7.01%, close 29 Oct to 5 Nov); the veto helped | - 2026-10-29 ZYDUSLIFE vetoed before 4 Nov results (stock -4.2% on results day): 5-day excess vs Nifty -5.94%; the veto helped | - 2026-10-27 AAPL (US) vetoed before 2 Nov results: 5-day excess vs S&P -2.73%; the veto helped (recorded late: earlier left out because the beat/miss was unverified, which only filtered out cases against the lesson) | + 2026-10-29 MET vetoed before 4 Nov results (record adjusted EPS): 5-day excess vs S&P +4.00% (close 29 Oct to 5 Nov) | + 2026-10-30 AUROPHARMA vetoed before 4-5 Nov results (record revenue, profit +32.5%, above estimates): 5-day excess vs Nifty +3.34% (review table, 11 Nov); the veto cost return | - 2026-11-02 BOSCHLTD vetoed before 6 Nov results (profit +19% but the stock fell on the day): 5-day excess vs Nifty -4.71% (review table, 11 Nov); the veto helped
